checkpoints.question: What changes between single and double quotes around `$PRACTICE_LABEL`?
checkpoints.model_answer: Single quotes keep `$PRACTICE_LABEL` as literal text. Double quotes expand the variable to its value.

checkpoints.question: Why should a path variable be double-quoted?
checkpoints.model_answer: Double quotes preserve spaces and special characters in a path value so the shell does not split it into separate arguments.
